name: Studies Anomalous Artifacts
description: You are a specialist in analyzing and understanding the properties of anomalous artifacts.
connectionOptions: One PC often comes to you for advice on strange objects they encounter.
You're writing a thesis on an artifact connected to one PC's background.
One PC is skeptical of your theories about artifacts.
You've been tracking an artifact that one PC's family heirloom might be related to.

abilities.name: Anomalous Insight
abilities.description: You are trained in identifying and analyzing anomalous artifacts. You can spend one Intellect point to get a general sense of an artifact's function or origin.

abilities.name: Safe Handling Protocols
abilities.description: You are trained in tasks related to safely containing and transporting anomalous objects.

abilities.name: Theoretical Application
abilities.description: You can spend an action theorizing about an artifact's potential uses. This gives you or an ally an asset on the next roll to use the artifact.

abilities.name: Artifact Categorization
abilities.description: You can accurately categorize an artifact's threat level and containment requirements after studying it for one minute.

abilities.name: Reverse Engineering
abilities.description: You can attempt to replicate a simple function of an artifact using conventional technology. This requires a day of work and appropriate materials.

abilities.name: Anomalous Breakthrough
abilities.description: Once per day, you can have a sudden insight about an artifact, potentially revealing hidden functions or dangers.

abilities.name: Artifact Mastery
abilities.description: You can attempt to fully understand and control an artifact's functions. This requires an hour of study and a difficult Intellect roll.
